Speaker: Book
Text: THE GLEANER'S LEDGER\n\nA name is not a summons. It is a question written down before anyone decides whether to ask it.
Notes: Buch für die Ledger Room; wird nach dem Memorial und vor Q01 übergeben.

Speaker: Book
Text: I keep names because memory is a poor lock. It opens for grief, closes for pride, and lets the most convenient story walk out wearing the truth's face.
Notes: Seite 1; Veyras Arbeitsmethode.

Speaker: Book
Text: First mark the deed. Then mark the silence after it. A killer who can describe the blood but not the hour afterward has told you only half a story.
Notes: Seite 1; keine pauschale Eignungsregel.

Speaker: Book
Text: Second: watch what remains when anger has spent itself. Remorse is not proof. Cruelty is not proof. The choice that follows is the part worth carrying to the Listener.
Notes: Seite 2; Listener entscheidet über Aufnahme.

Speaker: Book
Text: Third: never mistake hunger for devotion. The Dark Brotherhood needs hands that choose the knife, and minds that know when to put it away.
Notes: Seite 2; Veyras Deutung, keine universelle Sithis-Lehre.

Speaker: Book
Text: I have served Sithis in more than one house. The doors bore different names. The silence beyond them did not.
Notes: Seite 3; fraktionsübergreifende Tätigkeit angedeutet, keine konkrete Morag-Tong-Tatsache.

Speaker: Book
Text: The Mother speaks to her Listener. The Listener judges those I bring to the door. I offer names not commands.
Notes: Seite 3; Zuständigkeiten von Night Mother, Listener und Veyra.

Speaker: Book
Text: When a sanctuary burns, count what can still be taught. Count the doors that remain. Count the people who have not yet learned to call themselves lost.
Notes: Seite 4; Veyras Wiederaufbau-Motiv.

Speaker: Book
Text: First inquiry: Hjaalmarch. Hrefna Stormhollow, a Nord farmer, performed the Black Sacrament against the moneylender taking her farm. No answer came.
Notes: Seite 5; Q01-Anker nach Hrefnas Autorenprofil; ihre Tat und das Schicksal des Geldverleihers bleiben offen.

Speaker: Book
Text: She waited six weeks. Her husband drank, the cupboards emptied, and grief learned the shape of work. Begin in Morthal. Ask what the marsh returned.
Notes: Seite 5; Q01-Anker nach Hrefnas Autorenprofil; keine vorweggenommene Mordszene.

Speaker: Book
Text: Do not offer a place before you have heard the petitioner's story. Find the fisherman who remembers the water. Learn why the town calls the death an accident.
Notes: Seite 6; Hakan Reed-Walker als erster Ermittlungsanker; Veyra bleibt externe Helferin.

Speaker: Book
Text: If this ledger outlives me, let its keeper cross out every certainty I mistook for wisdom. A record that cannot be corrected is only another kind of lie.
Notes: Seite 6; Mysterium und Veyras Fehlbarkeit.

Speaker: Book
Text: DIARY OF ASH AND DOORS\n\nNo date. The ash had settled before I arrived. Someone had swept a path through it, then denied having hands.
Notes: Eigenes Buch in der Deep Sanctuary; rätselhafter Veyra-Text ohne Datierung.

Speaker: Book
Text: A child asked whether I belonged to the house. I asked which house she meant. She pointed to the one behind her, though there was only sky.
Notes: Seite 1; keine direkte Herkunftserklärung.

Speaker: Book
Text: I remember a voice before I remember a face. It told me that a closed door is still an answer. I have spent years deciding whether that was kindness.
Notes: Seite 2; Veyras Verhältnis zu Türen und Schweigen.

Speaker: Book
Text: The candle burned blue when I lied. It burned black when I told the truth. On the third night it burned without a flame, and I stopped asking it to choose.
Notes: Seite 2; mystisches Bild, keine technische Regel.

Speaker: Book
Text: I left a name beneath the floorboard. When I returned, the wood was bare and the name was waiting in my mouth. I did not write it down again.
Notes: Seite 3; absichtlich nicht auflösbares Rätsel.

Speaker: Book
Text: If this is found, do not ask when it was written. Ask why the ink has not dried. Some answers are only dangerous because they arrive before the question.
Notes: Seite 3; Schluss des Tagebuchs.

Speaker: Book
Text: SITHIS, AS I WAS TAUGHT\n\nSome call him the Void. Some call him the Dread Father. Some call the name a cage built by frightened mouths.
Notes: Persönlicher theologischer Text; widersprüchliche Tamriel-Traditionen.

Speaker: Book
Text: I was taught that Sithis is not the dark between things. He is the change that makes the space between them matter.
Notes: Seite 1; Veyras persönliche Deutung, keine objektive Kosmologie.

Speaker: Book
Text: The Brotherhood asks for a god who listens. I learned to serve a father who does not need to answer. That difference keeps a knife from becoming a prayer.
Notes: Seite 2; Veyra wahrt religiöse Mehrdeutigkeit.

Speaker: Book
Text: When a life ends, the Void does not applaud. When a life changes, the Void does not forgive. It opens, and what enters is ours to carry.
Notes: Seite 2; keine Behauptung über Sithis' universellen Willen.

Speaker: Book
Text: If you need certainty, kneel elsewhere. I have found only loyalty: a direction chosen again after every answer fails.
Notes: Seite 3; Veyras freiwillige Treue.

Speaker: Book
Text: The father in the prayer is older than the order that speaks his name. Whether that makes the order wise or merely late is a question for another page.
Notes: Seite 3; Trennung von Sithis und Brotherhood-Geschichte.

Speaker: Book
Text: THE HARVEST UNDER BLACK STARS\n\nThe old story says the field was empty until the first hand reached into the dark and found a seed that had never been planted.
Notes: Harvest-Legende; bewusst als überlieferte Geschichte markiert.

Speaker: Book
Text: The seed became a tree, the tree became a shadow, and the shadow learned the names of those who had mistaken hunger for destiny.
Notes: Seite 1; Veyras Erntemotiv.

Speaker: Book
Text: Every harvest leaves a gleaner behind. The reaper takes the fruit. The gleaner finds the fallen grain and asks whether it still remembers the field.
Notes: Seite 2; Herkunft des Titels Gleaner als Legende, nicht als belegte Chronik.

Speaker: Book
Text: Some say the gleaner serves the farmer. Some say the gleaner serves the soil. The oldest version says the gleaner serves the season that comes after.
Notes: Seite 2; konkurrierende Deutungen.

Speaker: Book
Text: When the field burns, the harvest is not saved by pretending the grain is unhurt. It is saved by finding what can still take root.
Notes: Seite 3; Veyras Wiederaufbau-Motiv.

Speaker: Book
Text: The story ends before the new field rises. Every teller leaves that page blank. A full ending would only be another field with no room for us.
Notes: Seite 3; offenes Ende.

Speaker: Book
Text: FIELD NOTES: SANCTUARIES\n\nA sanctuary is not a room beneath a road. It is the agreement that a person may sleep while another person keeps watch.
Notes: Praktische Veyra-Notizen; auf mehrere Sanctuarys übertragbar.

Speaker: Book
Text: First sign of failure: everyone knows who is to blame. Second sign: nobody knows who is responsible. Third sign: the candles are trimmed, but no one prays.
Notes: Seite 1; Beobachtung statt historischer Behauptung.

Speaker: Book
Text: Keep a table large enough for one more chair. A family that cannot make room has already begun to count itself dead.
Notes: Seite 2; Wiederaufbau und Zugehörigkeit.

Speaker: Book
Text: Do not seal every passage. A hidden door is useful until it becomes the only way out. Leave one route for the living and one for the truth.
Notes: Seite 2; Bezug auf die Deep Sanctuary.

Speaker: Book
Text: When the last survivor says the family is finished, ask who taught them to count. Numbers are obedient. Rooms are not.
Notes: Seite 3; Veyras Skepsis gegenüber endgültigen Urteilen.

Speaker: Book
Text: A keeper who never leaves the ledger becomes its prisoner. Walk the halls. Hear the doors. Let the names become faces before you decide what they owe you.
Notes: Seite 3; Veyras Selbstkritik.

Speaker: Book
Text: THE FIVEFOLD SILENCE\n\nOne tale says a mother offered five children to the dark. Another says the tale was written by five children who needed a mother.
Notes: Night-Mother-Legende; widersprüchliche Überlieferung ausdrücklich erhalten.

Speaker: Book
Text: A third tale says there were no children at all, only five names spoken over a bowl of ash. The bowl was real. That is the only part every teller keeps.
Notes: Seite 1; keine Festlegung auf eine genealogische Wahrheit.

Speaker: Book
Text: Years later, a voice called one listener from the dark. The others heard nothing. They built an order around the silence and called it proof.
Notes: Seite 2; Night-Mother-/Listener-Tradition.

Speaker: Book
Text: If the mother was a woman, the title remembers her. If the mother was a story, the title remembers us. Both can be true until someone mistakes memory for a witness.
Notes: Seite 2; Lore-Mehrdeutigkeit.

Speaker: Book
Text: Keep the names if you must. Keep the doubt as well. A family built on one unquestioned story will eventually sacrifice its living to protect the dead.
Notes: Seite 3; Verbindung zu Veyras Grundsätzen.

Speaker: Book
Text: HREFNA STORMHOLLOW'S FARM LEDGER\n\nSpring: two sacks of barley lost to rain. One axle split. Eirik says the debt has grown teeth.
Notes: Fundort Q01 Stage 20; Hrefnas alter Hof; keine Questlogik.

Speaker: Book
Text: Summer: the north field held. My husband did not. He drinks before noon and calls it courage when I ask him to stop.
Notes: Seite 1; Hrefnas Ehemann und die finanzielle Belastung.

Speaker: Book
Text: Autumn: Eirik marked the west field with red chalk. He says a mark is not a sentence. He has never had to live beneath one.
Notes: Seite 2; Eiriks Pfändungsdrohung wird angedeutet.

Speaker: Book
Text: Winter: I counted the flour twice. I counted the arrows three times. I did not count the days until I began to fear the answer.
Notes: Seite 2; Hrefnas praktische, schuldgeprägte Stimme.

Speaker: Book
Text: UNSENT LETTER\n\nTo the Mother in the dark: Eirik Ashmark is taking the farm, the animals, and whatever is left of my husband's name. I ask for an answer.
Notes: Fundort Q01 Stage 20; Hrefnas Black Sacrament wird als Bitte, nicht als Lösung dargestellt.

Speaker: Book
Text: I have followed the words as they were given. Heart, skull, flesh, bones, nightshade. I do not know whether the order matters. I only know that I did it alone.
Notes: Seite 1; Ritualdetails ohne neue Lorebehauptung.

Speaker: Book
Text: If someone comes, let them come before the roof goes. If no one comes, let the dark at least remember that I asked.
Notes: Seite 2; Night Mother bleibt im Hintergrund und antwortet nicht sichtbar.

Speaker: Book
Text: I cannot keep waiting. The flour is nearly gone. If no one comes, I will have to do something myself.
Notes: Seite 2; leitet Hrefnas spätere eigene Entscheidung ein.

Speaker: Book
Text: NOTES FROM THE MOOR\n\nDay seven: no answer. Eirik sent another boy to measure the fence. The boy would not meet my eyes.
Notes: Fundort Q01 Stage 30; nach der ersten Untersuchung des Hofs.

Speaker: Book
Text: Day twenty-one: my husband drank through the morning and slept through the rain. I put the knife away. Then I put it somewhere else.
Notes: Seite 1; Hrefnas Schwanken zwischen Handlung und Zurückhaltung.

Speaker: Book
Text: Day forty-two: the answer did not come. I found Eirik at the waterline, laughing at the deed in his hand. I asked him to give it back.
Notes: Seite 2; unmittelbare Vorgeschichte des Mordes, aber kein vollständiger Ablauf.

Speaker: Book
Text: He said the farm was already his. I keep writing that he slipped. I keep crossing it out.
Notes: Seite 2; starker Verdacht statt vorgezogenem Geständnis; Hrefnas persönliche Einordnung bleibt Stage 40.

Speaker: Book
Text: I washed the cup. Scrubbed the table. There is always something that needs cleaning. It helps until I stop.
Notes: Seite 3; Schuld, Trauer und die Beziehung bleiben offen.

Speaker: Book
Text: NOTICE OF DEBT\n\nTo Hrefna Stormhollow: payment is overdue. The west field, livestock, tools, and dwelling are collateral against the outstanding sum.
Notes: Fundort Q01 Stage 20; Eiriks Forderungsschreiben.

Speaker: Book
Text: You have been granted one final extension. Do not mistake patience for mercy. The mark will be made public when the next moon turns.
Notes: Seite 1; Eiriks Macht über den Hof.

Speaker: Book
Text: Bring the keys to my office in Morthal. Bring your husband if he can stand. Bring no priest, no guard, and no story about bad harvests.
Notes: Seite 1; Drohung ohne neue Nebenfigurgeschichte.

Speaker: Book
Text: Eirik Ashmark. This notice will be retained with the account.
Notes: Seite 2; Abschluss des Forderungsschreibens; gemeinsam mit 055–057 in Stage 20.

Speaker: Book
Text: FIELD NOTE – HJAALMARCH\n\nLocals call Ashmark's death an accident. No witness will speak plainly.
Notes: Fundort Q01 Stage 60; Quintus' Unterlagen.

Speaker: Book
Text: Hrefna Stormhollow: Nord farmer. Farm seized for debt. Husband reportedly drinking heavily. Defensive when questioned. Do not approach her without a second route out.
Notes: Seite 1; Quintus beobachtet Hrefna, versteht sie aber nur teilweise.

Speaker: Book
Text: Ritual remains indicate a deliberate petition. No Brotherhood contact confirmed. Watch the farm and question anyone asking after Ashmark.
Notes: Seite 2; Quintus bleibt bei beobachtbaren Hinweisen und offenen Ermittlungsfragen.

Speaker: Book
Text: If the woman killed Ashmark, she may be useful to the Brotherhood. If she did not, someone else is using the marsh to hide a better story.
Notes: Seite 2; Quintus ist Ermittler, kein allwissender Erzähler.

Speaker: Book
Text: LEDGER ENTRY: HREFNA STORMHOLLOW\n\nCandidate: Nord woman, farmer, Hjaalmarch. Last known home: a small holding outside Morthal. Begin there if the townspeople cannot tell you where she went.
Notes: Erweiterte Q01-Ledgerfassung; Profil- und Ermittlungsdaten, kein neues Questziel.

Speaker: Book
Text: When I first watched the farm, it was being emptied. Barley, tools, animals, and finally the right to stand beneath one's own roof had been measured against a debt.
Notes: Hjaalmarch-Eintrag; Eiriks Pfändungsdruck als frühere Beobachtung.

Speaker: Book
Text: Creditor: Eirik Ashmark. Moneylender, Morthal. His notices use patience as a threat and legality as a locked door. He prefers witnesses who need wages.
Notes: Eirik-Profil; keine zusätzliche Oculatus-Verbindung vor Q01.

Speaker: Book
Text: Household condition: husband drinking heavily, courage performed loudly before noon. Hrefna counts flour, arrows, and unpaid days. She does not count her own exhaustion until it becomes a weapon.
Notes: Hrefna-Profil; Beobachtung ihrer Schuld- und Versorgungslogik.

Speaker: Book
Text: She performed the Black Sacrament. No answer came. Whatever failed between her prayer and our arrival, she was left to bear the waiting.
Notes: Sithis/Night-Mother-Lore bleibt mehrdeutig; keine Behauptung über göttliche Ablehnung.

Speaker: Book
Text: Six weeks is long enough for hope to become a chore. It is also long enough for a person to mistake endurance for permission. Ask what she did with the time.
Notes: Q01-Untersuchungsfrage; keine vorweggenommene Tatbeschreibung.

Speaker: Book
Text: The marsh keeps records without ink. Footprints fill. Water carries weight. A town chooses the word accident when the truth would require a name.
Notes: Moor- und Morthal-Motiv; führt zur Untersuchung des Todesfalls.

Speaker: Book
Text: Find Hakan Reed-Walker first. He knows the marsh. Ask what he noticed, and what made him decide to keep it to himself.
Notes: Q01-Ermittlungsanker; Hakan als Nebenfigur aus dem Autorenprofil.

Speaker: Book
Text: Search the farm before you seek Hrefna. When you find her, begin with what she lost, not what you suspect.
Notes: Gesprächsführung für Q01; Hrefnas Perspektive vor der Prüfung.

Speaker: Book
Text: If she killed Ashmark, the act may have begun in grief and continued by choice. If she did not, grief has still taught her how to hide a wound.
Notes: Veyras offene Hypothese; keine vorweggenommene Auflösung.

Speaker: Book
Text: If she killed him, ask whether she could choose the work without that first grievance. Another death alone would tell us little.
Notes: Q01-Prüfungskriterium; knüpft an Hrefnas Schwäche und die E23-Arbeitsweise an.

Speaker: Book
Text: Do not mistake a full account for a true one. Let Hrefna contradict this page. I recorded what I observed, not everything she is.
Notes: Veyras Fehlbarkeit; der Listener soll selbst urteilen.

Speaker: Book
Text: Record after the meeting: listen for the moment she stops speaking about what happened and begins speaking about what she chose. That is where the recruit begins.
Notes: Notiz für die spätere Q01-Auswertung; keine automatische Entscheidung.

Speaker: Book
Text: FESTUS KREX\n\nA sharp tongue, a practiced hand. His place at the table remains.
Notes: Activator Record NHV_Act_Q00_PlaqueFestus (003DA1); Name: Festus Krex. Epitaph für spätere Lesefunktion.

Speaker: Book
Text: GABRIELLA\n\nA measured voice, a practiced blade. The family remembers both.
Notes: Activator Record NHV_Act_Q00_PlaqueGabriella (003DA2); Name: Gabriella. Epitaph für spätere Lesefunktion.

Speaker: Book
Text: ARNBJORN\n\nThe beast served the family. The man beside it was family too.
Notes: Activator Record NHV_Act_Q00_PlaqueArnbjorn (003DA3); Name: Arnbjorn. Epitaph für spätere Lesefunktion.

Speaker: Book
Text: VEEZARA\n\nA hidden blade, a measured breath. His enemies learned too late where the dark began.
Notes: Activator Record NHV_Act_Q00_PlaqueVeezara (003DA4); Name: Veezara. Epitaph für spätere Lesefunktion.

Speaker: Book
Text: ASTRID\n\nShe led this family. Her failures do not erase her name.
Notes: Activator Record NHV_Act_Q00_PlaqueAstrid (003DA5); Name: Astrid. Wahl 1, große Plakette bei den anderen.

Speaker: Book
Text: ASTRID\n\nRemembered, but not honored. Her name remains where the family can see it.
Notes: Kein eigener Activator-Record; verwendet NHV_Act_Q00_PlaqueAstrid (003DA5). Wahl 3, kleine Plakette darunter; abweichender Text für spätere Lesefunktion.

Speaker: Book
Text:
PENITUS OCULATUS — EASTERN HARBOR

Observe the laborers who move after the bell. Offer fair measure before asking for names. A frightened witness is a door; a grateful one is a key.

Argonian workers: record shifts, debts, quarrels, and absences. Do not call this persecution. Call it prevention. Forward all patterns to the northern desk under seal.
Notes: Oculatus-Fragment 2; liegt bei Aelius. Der Text bestätigt das Informantennetz, ohne Aelius' Freundlichkeit als vollständig gespielt zu entwerten.; superseded by NHV_Q02_070_6000/6001 (E55)

Speaker: Book
Text: REED-WALKER'S KNOT\n\nFlat hitch. Marsh cord. It holds when wet and loosens when the hand remembers where to pull.
Notes: Lesetext für NHV_MISC_ReedWalkersKnot; optionales Beweisstück, kein Questfortschritt allein.

Speaker: Book
Text: THE DROWNED POOL\n\nBreathe before you enter. Leave no name to the water that you are unwilling to carry back out.
Notes: Kurze Inschrift für NHV_Act_DrownedPoolNameBowl; Raum-Lore nach erfolgreicher Rekrutierung.

Speaker: Book
Text:
PENITUS OCULATUS — HJAALMARCH

Subject: repeated Black Sacrament activity. Record the petitioner, the named target, the local witness, and any surviving household. Do not intervene before the pattern is confirmed.

Forward copies to the northern desk. A prayer unanswered is still a signal.
Notes: Oculatus-Fragment 1; Quintus' dispatch, im Besitz des Spielers nach dem Fund.

Speaker: Book
Text:
HREFNA'S DIARY — SIXTH WEEK

The wick burned out before the answer came. I lit another. I wrote the words again. The page stayed dry.

Tomorrow I go to the bog. I will ask him once. Then I will stop asking.
Notes: Optionaler Tagebuchauszug; verdichtet Hrefnas Warten, ohne Eiriks Tod direkt zu erklären.

Speaker: Book
Text: BOGWIFE'S KNIFE\n\nA narrow blade, blackened at the spine and bright at the edge. It was made for roots, reeds, and work that must be finished quietly.
Notes: Flavortext für NHV_Weap_BogwifesKnife; Q01-Recruit-Belohnung.

Speaker: Book
Text: To my little owl,\n\nYour last letter caught up with me in Morthal. I have been counting other people's troubles again. You would say I ought to finish my own work before taking on theirs.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Neuer V2-Brief zum bereits vorgesehenen Daughter-Beat; kein Ersatz eines aktiven Buchs.

Speaker: Book
Text:
I still hope to be home before Frostfall. Hope is an awkward word to send a child, but I would rather write it than promise another day I cannot keep.

Keep a page for me in your stories. I will bring mine.

Father
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Privater Brief ohne Oculatus-Enthüllung; in der Zimmervariante vor Hrefnas Zögern sichtbar.

Speaker: Book
Text: To the one who came,\n\nI am still in Hjaalmarch. There is work if you do not ask too much about the roof over it. I have been mending nets. The hands remember that work too.
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Nur outcome=released; sieben Spieltage später. Keine vollständige Wiederherstellung des gepfändeten Hofs.

Speaker: Book
Text:
I will not write down what happened. You know. I know. I wanted to tell you I have lit no more candles in the cellar. There are things I must decide without waiting for someone at the door.

Thank you for letting me leave.

Hrefna
Notes: INACTIVE V2; Freilassung ist kein versteckter Vertrag; keine Tochter Svala hinzuerfinden.

Speaker: Book
Text: ACCOUNT OF EIRIK ASHMARK\n\nDebt transferred: Stormhollow farm. Payment overdue. Occupant instructed to vacate after the next moon.
Notes: Draft evidence; no supernatural claim.

Speaker: Book
Text: The heart was fresh. The skull was clean. The nightshade was measured. If no one came, the fault was not in the words.
Notes: Hrefna’s ritual note; ambiguity remains.

Speaker: Book
Text: Hjaalmarch case: repeated Black Sacraments, no confirmed Listener response. Treat each site as a possible signal. Do not disclose the pattern to local authorities.
Notes: Quintus fragment; not a complete conspiracy.

Speaker: Book
Text: Moorside guest register: Q. Aufidius, trader; paid in Imperial coin; requested directions to Stormhollow and the old watchpost.
Notes: Research clue.

Speaker: Book
Text:
To my daughter,

I will return when this work is done. Do not mistake delay for forgetting. I am still writing down the names.

Father
Notes: Private letter to Quintus’s daughter; found among the inn documents.

Speaker: Book
Text: A prayer unanswered is still a signal. Compare sites by date, ritual accuracy, and the length of the silence.
Notes: Campaign hook; does not name Livia or Veyra.

Speaker: Book
Text: IMPERIAL WATCH - RELIEF SLIP\n\nOld Watchpost, Morthal road. Four on the post. Report to the scout, not to the garrison. Nothing is written down twice.
Notes: PLACEHOLDER (Claude) - Codex rewrite per docs/codex/2026-10-01-Q01-Patrol-Slip.md; farm clue to the watchpost.

Speaker: Book
Text: PENITUS OCULATUS — EASTERN HARBOR\n\nObserve the laborers who move after the bell. Offer fair measure before asking for names. A frightened witness is a door; a grateful one is a key.
Notes: ENHANCED E46/E55; E55: text of NHV_Note_Dispatch02 (Fragment 2), part 1

Notes: ENHANCED E46/E55; E55: text of NHV_Note_Dispatch02 (Fragment 2), part 2

Speaker: Book
Text:
TIDEHOUSE WATCH LEDGER — EASTERN PIER

Late bell: south net crew.
Missing: two names from the night shift.
Correction in Aelius Varro's hand: Ask what the water returned before you ask who cast it.

The ink stops where the page was torn.
Notes: ENHANCED E46/E55; Tidehouse ledger recovered at stage 15 (item NHV_Book_Q02_TidehouseLedger, E49); partial link to Aelius

Speaker: Book
Text:
PRIVATE RECKONING — A. VARRO

The eastern ledgers I write in the old shift. Count the piers between the tidehouse and the sluice, and move every letter forward by that count. Three. The northern copies need no other key.
Notes: E56: optional cipher key in Aelius' desk; Phase B draft text (lore-editor review 01.10.2026), Codex / lore-editor follow-up requested.

Speaker: Book
Text:
TORBJORN ICE-VEIN - HARBOR SLATE

Four bodies since the thaw, all Nords, all bound with the same hitch. Complaints are on file against Haldor Frost-Knuckle and his night crew, but a complaint is not a verdict.

Sergeant Hjorald holds the key to the sealed tidehouse, where the watch log lies. Ask what the night shift saw after the late bell.
Notes: DEATH FALLBACK (03.10.2026): item NHV_Note_Fallback_Torbjorn, name 'Harbor Slate'. Torbjorn (E58 style fallback): replaces his stage 10 hub, the bridge to the tidehouse (10_4091) and the body talk hints (20_4000/4001/4005)

Speaker: Book
Text:
TIDEHOUSE KEY - SERGEANT HJORALD

Tidehouse sealed after the fourth body. The log stays inside, and nobody takes it out.

The log records late shifts, missing names, and Aelius Varro's neat corrections. It shows a pattern, not a killer.
Notes: DEATH FALLBACK (03.10.2026): item NHV_Note_Fallback_Hjorald, name 'Watch Key Tag'. Hjorald fallback: replaces the key talk (15_4200-4204) and the ledger report (15_4214/4215)

Speaker: Book
Text:
NIGHT CREW ROSTER - H. FROST-KNUCKLE

East pier after the late bell: four men on the roster, one short again. Something splashes under the planks most nights, and the lads will not stand at the end of the pier alone.

Anyone who loses a knife finds me at the salt yard. If the guards ask, the crew saw nothing.
Notes: DEATH FALLBACK (03.10.2026): item NHV_Note_Fallback_Haldor, name 'Crumpled Dock Roster'. Haldor fallback: replaces the night scene hints (30_4000-4002) and the salt yard lead (35_4301/4304)

Speaker: Book
Text:
DRINKS-THE-BRINE - NET TALLY

Knots counted by the dozen, nothing else written. The hitch on the dead men is a marsh hitch, learned where the reeds grow, not on a Nord's boat.

The old sluice lies behind the salt bins. Haldor's friends watch the yard, so keep low and do not follow the street.
Notes: DEATH FALLBACK (03.10.2026): item NHV_Note_Fallback_Drinks, name 'Net Tally'. Drinks fallback: replaces the hitch hint (10_4019/4020) and the sluice lead (35_4301/4305/4310)

Speaker: Book
Text:
SINGS-BENEATH-ICE - NAMES ON THE SLATE

A slate scratched with names. Four are crossed out, the warm-bloods who laughed when we were hurt. One is not: Aelius Varro, the harbor clerk, who paid fair and learned our names.

Beneath it: Fear has been a poor teacher.
Notes: DEATH FALLBACK (03.10.2026): item NHV_Note_Fallback_SingsBeneathIce, name 'Scratched Slate'. Sings fallback: replaces the confession (50_4008-4022) when he dies before the judgment

Speaker: Book
Text:
A. VARRO - HARBOR CLERK

Argonian net crew to the dry shift; their hands are split to the bone. No man loses pay because a clerk prefers a clean ledger.

I keep their names so I can send word when a body comes up. Whoever reads my tallies up north reads them closely, and I answer what is asked.
Notes: DEATH FALLBACK (03.10.2026): item NHV_Note_Fallback_Aelius, name 'Clerk's Pocket Ledger'. Aelius fallback: replaces the observation scene (55_4402/4403) when he is dead before it

Speaker: Book
Text:
WINDHELM WATCH - ORDER OF SEALING

By order of the Windhelm Watch, the desk of the harbor clerk is sealed upon his death. His papers are to be collected under escort and forwarded to the northern desk.

No person outside the roster may handle them.
Notes: DEATH FALLBACK (03.10.2026): item NHV_Note_Fallback_Courier, name 'Sealed Order'. Courier fallback: replaces the courier encounter (70_4501/4503) when he dies before the talk ends

Speaker: Book
Text:
TIDEHOUSE AND SALT YARD - WATCH ORDERS

The tidehouse stays shut, and the log does not leave it. Haldor's friends hold the salt yard until his knife turns up.

Aelius Varro keeps the shift tallies; we keep the dead, and nobody mixes the two. Anyone asking questions is turned around at the door.
Notes: DEATH FALLBACK (03.10.2026): item NHV_Note_Fallback_DockEnforcer, name 'Watch Orders Slip'. Enforcer fallback: replaces the Hello talks (15_4210-4212, 35_4302/4304); put on one corpse by script (GiveEnforcerNote), not in the clone base

Speaker: Book
Text:
HAKAN'S NOTES

Found Eirik face down in the reeds, purse still tied, boots dry inside. The bog did not take him. Men with hooks work the reedbed and took my red ferry marker. Look to the Stormhollow farm, east of the reed road.
Notes: FALLBACK-NOTE (Claude, 03.10.2026): lootable body item NHV_Note_Fallback_Hakan (0x00AD40) if the NPC dies before the dialogue; check by lore-editor, Codex may rewrite.

Speaker: Book
Text:
HREFNA'S LAST WORDS

Six weeks of candles, empty cupboards, and a door that stayed shut. Eirik took the farm on paper, so I took his breath in the water. I hid the ritual remains because I could bear an empty answer, but not a town laughing at the question. The debts broke my husband, and Eirik's hired man broke my daughter. After that, waiting stopped being a virtue.
Notes: FALLBACK-NOTE (Claude, 03.10.2026): lootable body item NHV_Note_Fallback_Hrefna (0x00AD41) if the NPC dies before the dialogue; check by lore-editor, Codex may rewrite.

Speaker: Book
Text:
SCOUT'S REPORT

To the Penitus Oculatus, Hjaalmarch post. Eirik Ashmark drowned near Morthal; his debtor's cellar holds a ritual petition. The witness, a woman who prayed, was last seen at a camp beyond the drowned shrine. Take her alive. A dead witness answers nothing.
Notes: FALLBACK-NOTE (Claude, 03.10.2026): lootable body item NHV_Note_Fallback_Scout (0x00AD42) if the NPC dies before the dialogue; check by lore-editor, Codex may rewrite.

Speaker: Book
Text:
DEBT PAPER

Debt of Eirik Ashmark, sold on to the bearer. A seal on the page, no name beneath it. Search the reedbed sack and keep the red ferry marker. Hungry men need no other order.
